verdict.rationale: Gmail documents search operators for filtering results (gmail-docs-12) and offline search across mail (gmail-docs-9), plus server-side filters that act on matching criteria (gmail-docs-15, gmail-docs-28), supporting operator-based, filtered search. However, there's no evidence on ranking quality, performance/speed at scale, or completeness of full mail history search, and no independent corroboration of search speed/precision claims. Missing for 10: evidence on ranking algorithm/relevance quality, speed benchmarks at scale, and independent hands-on validation of search across full history.
